legal.privacy_policy_content:
## Mwachidule
**{{brandName}}** ndi mapulogalamu apakompyuta otsegula ndipo atha kuperekedwa kudzera mwa ovomerezeka kapena okhazikitsa okha. Pakukhazikitsa uku, wowongolera data kapena wogwiritsa ntchito ndi **{{controllerName}}**.
- **Adilesi yowongolera:** {{controllerAddress}}
- **Kulumikizana pazinsinsi:** {{privacyEmail}}
- **Kulumikizana nawo pafupipafupi:** {{supportEmail}}

Chidziwitsochi chikufotokozera ** zomwe deta yaumwini imakonzedwa **, **momwe imapezedwa **, ** chifukwa chiyani imakonzedwa **, ** ndani angalandire **, ** yomwe imasungidwa kwa nthawi yayitali bwanji **, ndi ** maufulu omwe mungakhale nawo **.

Ngati kuyikaku kumayendetsedwa ndi munthu wina, wogwiritsa ntchitoyo ndiye kuti ali ndi udindo wodziwitsa wolamulira wina aliyense, zomwe akuyenera kuchita, kusamutsa zambiri, zosunga zobwezeretsera, ndi zidziwitso zamalamulo zakuderalo zomwe zikugwira ntchito.

## Zomwe timasonkhanitsa ndikukonza
- **Zidziwitso zaakaunti:** lolowera, imelo adilesi, mawu achinsinsi, makeke agawo, data yodalirika yazida, ndi zolemba zachitetezo.
- **Zidziwitso zautumiki: ** nyumba, zipinda, magulu, zinthu, media zokwezedwa, zopempha zobwereketsa, ndi zolemba zanu zomwe mumapanga.
- **Zaukadaulo:** adilesi ya IP, zozindikiritsa msakatuli/gawo, ndi zokonda zachilankhulo zomwe zimafunikira kuti mumasulidwe komanso chitetezo cha akaunti.
- **Zida zomwe simukuzikonda:** mukasankha Google Sign-In, Google imagawana nafe imelo adilesi yanu, chizindikiritso cha akaunti ya Google, ndi dzina lowonetsa mbiri yanu kuti tikutsimikizireni kapena kupanga akaunti yanu.
- **Pempho losasankha:** ngati mugwiritsa ntchito barcode kapena kuyang'ana zinthu, mtengo wa barcode womwe mwatumiza ukhoza kutumizidwa ndi seva yathu ku Open Food Facts, Open Products Facts, Open Beauty Facts, kapena Google kuti zotsatira zomwe mwapempha zibwezedwe.

## Momwe timapezera deta
- ** Mwachindunji kuchokera kwa inu: ** mukalembetsa, kulowa, kupanga kapena kusintha ma rekodi, kukweza media, sinthani zosintha zachitetezo, kapena kulumikizana ndi chithandizo.
- **Zokha kuchokera pa msakatuli wanu kapena chipangizo chanu:** kudzera m'makuke agawo omwe amafunikira, makina odalirika azipangizo, kugwiritsa ntchito IP, zokonda zachilankhulo, ndi zolemba zachitetezo zofunika kuti mugwiritse ntchito ndikuteteza pulogalamuyi.
- **Kuchokera ku Google:** pokhapokha mutasankha Google Sign-In, zokhazo zomwe zimafunikira kukutsimikizirani kapena kupanga akaunti yanu.
- **Kuchokera kuzinthu zakunja:** pokhapokha mutayambitsa barcode kapena kuyang'ana kwazinthu, zochepera pa pempho loyang'ana ndikubweza metadata yazinthu.

## Chifukwa chiyani timachikonza
- **Kugwiritsa ntchito Akaunti: ** kuti mupange ndikugwiritsa ntchito akaunti yanu.
- **Kutsimikizika ndi chitetezo:** kukutsimikizirani ndikuteteza magawo ndi kutsimikizika kwazinthu ziwiri.
- ** Zoyambira: ** kuti mupereke zosungira, zosunga zobwezeretsera, ndi mawonekedwe a Personal Vault.
- **Thandizo: ** kuyankha zopempha zothandizira.
- **Zosankha zolowera ndi kuyang'ana:** kuti mumalize Kulowa mu Google ndikuyang'ana kunja kwa barcode/chinthu pokhapokha mwasankha izi.
- **Zofunikira pazamalamulo ndi chitetezo:** kukwaniritsa zofunikira pazamalamulo kapena zachitetezo.

## Maziko ovomerezeka ndi njira yotolera
- **Pansi pa GDPR, ngati kuli koyenera:** kukonza kumatengera magwiridwe antchito a kontrakitala, udindo wazamalamulo, kuvomereza chilichonse chogwirizana ndi chilolezo, komanso chidwi chovomerezeka cha wogwiritsa ntchito pa ntchito ndi chitetezo cha akaunti.
- **Pansi pa KVKK, ngati kuli koyenera:** kukonza kumakhazikitsidwa pazifukwa zamalamulo mu Ndime 5 ndi 6, kuphatikiza ngati kuli kofunikira pakukhazikitsa kapena kuchita mgwirizano, kutsata malamulo, kugwiritsa ntchito kapena kuteteza ufulu, kapena zokomera zovomerezeka za woyang'anira malinga ngati ufulu wanu wofunikira ndi ufulu wanu sizikuvulazidwa.
- **Njira yosonkhanitsira:** data imasonkhanitsidwa ndi njira zamagetsi kudzera m'mafomu, magawo ovomerezeka, makeke ofunikira, ma OAuth osasankha, logi la mapulogalamu, zokwezedwa, ndi zopempha za API.

## Kusunga ndi kusamutsa
- **Sitigulitsa zaumwini.**
- Zambiri zamunthu zitha kulandiridwa ndi omwe akuchititsa, nkhokwe, kusungirako, imelo, kutsimikizika, ndi omwe amapereka zida zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito pokhazikitsa izi.
- Mukasankha Google Sign-In kapena barcode/kufufuza zinthu, kutsimikizika koyenera kapena kufufuza komwe kumagawidwa ndi omwe mwamusankha kuti mumalize zomwe mwayambitsa.
- Zambiri zitha kuwululidwa ku makhothi, oyang'anira, kapena akuluakulu aboma pakafunidwa mwalamulo.
- **Kuwulura kwakusamutsa pakukhazikitsa uku:** {{transferDisclosure}}

- Mukachotsa akaunti yanu pa Zochunira, data ya akaunti yanu, zomwe zili m'malo osungiramo zinthu zakale, media zomwe zidakwezedwa, ndi zolemba zamapulogalamu a akaunti yanu zimachotsedwa pa pulogalamuyo mosachedwetsa, kupatula zidziwitso zomwe ziyenera kusungidwa pamilandu, ntchito zamalamulo, kapena chitetezo.
